timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,350 KRW/USD

WHY: The news explicitly forecasts the exchange rate approaching 1,350 won per dollar next week, which represents a weakening won (higher KRW per USD). This means the user will need to spend more Korean won to obtain their fixed $2,000, making it more expensive than when the won is stronger.

TIP: Consider waiting for won strength (lower KRW/USD levels) to execute your monthly conversion, or use dollar-cost averaging if you cannot time the market precisely.
